remarks: Stunning Waterfront Condo with Breathtaking Views! This beautifully renovated second-floor unit boasts elevator access and an open, airy layout with gorgeous flooring throughout. Enjoy commanding views of the lawn and harbor from every angle. The sleek white kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a spacious pantry with an interior window to preserve the stunning views. The living and dining areas are perfect for entertaining, complete with a cozy fireplace, dry bar, and a balcony ideal for watching boats, birds, and breathtaking sunsets. The primary bedroom offers ample closet space and a spa-like bath with a huge walk-in shower. This home, along with the immaculate grounds of the complex, is truly a seaside delight!
